description: Find new Solana token launches and pump.fun tokens, browse trending pools, search by name/symbol, or look up a token/pool address.

dex.description: Only return pools from one Solana DEX. Choose 'All DEXes' to keep every pool.
dex.title: DEX

maxAgeMinutes.description: Only keep pools created within this many minutes. Set 0 to disable the age filter.
maxAgeMinutes.title: Maximum pool age (minutes)

maxItems.description: Upper limit on the number of token/pool records to return.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxMarketCapUsd.description: Drop tokens above this market cap. Useful for finding very new, small launches.
maxMarketCapUsd.title: Maximum market cap (USD)

minLiquidityUsd.description: Drop pools with less than this much liquidity. Leave empty to keep every pool.
minLiquidityUsd.title: Minimum liquidity (USD)

minMarketCapUsd.description: Drop tokens below this market cap. Uses market cap when available, otherwise fully diluted valuation.
minMarketCapUsd.title: Minimum market cap (USD)

minVolume24hUsd.description: Drop pools with less than this much 24h trading volume. Leave empty to keep every pool.
minVolume24hUsd.title: Minimum 24h volume (USD)

mode.description: Choose the feed: newest Solana pools, pump.fun launches, trending pools, keyword search, or one token/pool lookup.
enumTitles: Search Solana pools by name or symbol
Token or pool details by address
Legacy: Latest tokens (same as New Solana pool launches)
Legacy: New pools (same as New Solana pool launches)
Legacy: Trending tokens (same as Trending Solana pools)
Legacy: Search tokens (same as Search Solana pools)
mode.sectionDescription: Pick the feed that matches your use case. Filters below work with the list modes; token details always return the requested token or pool.
mode.title: What do you want to scrape?

pumpFunOnly.description: Only return tokens launched on pump.fun or trading on Pump.fun/PumpSwap. Applies to pool, trending and search feeds.
pumpFunOnly.title: Pump.fun ecosystem only

pumpfunStatus.description: Keep all pump.fun tokens, only tokens still on the bonding curve, or only tokens that graduated to a DEX. Applies to pump.fun and pool feeds.
pumpfunStatus.title: Pump.fun launch stage

query.description: Token name, symbol or keyword. Required when mode is 'Search Solana pools by name or symbol'.
query.sectionDescription: Used by the search and token-details modes.
query.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Keep the source ranking, or sort by age, 24h volume, liquidity, 24h price change, market cap or last trade time. Missing values sort last.
enumTitles: Legacy: Creation date (same as Newest first)
Legacy: Price change (same as 24h price change)
sortBy.title: Sort results by

tokenAddress.description: A Solana token mint or pool address. Required when mode is 'Token or pool details by address'.
tokenAddress.title: Token or pool address

title: Pump.fun & Solana New Pool Launch Tracker Input
